inactive.label: 青棱抱着书打盹
inactive.hint: 回来后再一起核对余额

en.label: Qingleng dozes with her book
en.hint: Come back and we will check the balance together.

en.label: My crystal pin blinks
en.hint: The next refresh will not slip past me.

inactive.label: 猫耳听见了风声
inactive.hint: 先让思路也休息一会儿

en.label: These ears caught the wind
en.hint: Let your thinking rest a while too.

en.label: Qingleng has it covered
en.hint: The balance will report to you itself.

bubble.label: 猫耳听见你了
bubble.hint: 点击角色可以刷新余额

en.label: Heard you, loud and clear
en.hint: Tap me to refresh the balance. Go on.

en.label: One blink from the pin
en.hint: I will keep watching the balance for you.

bubble.label: 黑色小书翻开了
bubble.hint: 完成后会显示本次消耗

en.label: The black book opens
en.hint: This refresh's cost will be written down when it is done.

bubble.label: 模块已经对齐
bubble.hint: 先确认余额，再开始下一项任务

en.label: Modules aligned.
en.hint: Check the balance first, then take on the next task.

bubble.label: 青棱自称大姐头
bubble.hint: 这块地盘是我带着人打下来的，接下来的路，跟好大姐头。

en.label: Qingleng: call me boss
en.hint: I fought for this ground with my own crew; keep close, kid.

en.label: Caught on. Ears up.
en.hint: A bonus for the persistent. Do not tell the others.

streak.label: 方晶连续闪烁
streak.hint: 这一组输入已经记住了

en.label: The pin flashes four times
en.hint: That whole input sequence is memorized.

en.label: Qingleng shuts the book
en.hint: The modules are re-aligning. Give it a second.

hair.label: 猫耳被碰到
hair.hint: 青棱的耳朵轻轻抖了一下

en.label: My ear was touched
en.hint: Qingleng twitches one ear, unbothered.

en.label: Hands off the nightcap
en.hint: The crystal charm will hang crooked.

hair.label: 蓝色吊坠响了一声
hair.hint: 模块已经收到你的信号

en.label: The blue charm chimes
en.hint: Signal received. The modules know you are here.

en.label: Oh — my cheek
en.hint: Qingleng will not admit to blushing.

en.label: Softer, alright?
en.hint: Still on balance duty, do not fret.

mouth.label: 猫耳助手抿起嘴
mouth.hint: 再戳就把这一项记进小书

en.label: The cat-eared aide sulks
en.hint: Poke once more and it goes in the little book.

en.label: Felt that poke.
en.hint: Tap me and the balance refreshes.

body.label: 黑色小书亮了一下
body.hint: 余额变化会及时告诉你

en.label: The black book glints
en.hint: Balance changes come to you without delay.

body.label: 青棱对齐了方晶
body.hint: 完成后会显示本次消耗

en.label: Crystal realigned.
en.hint: The cost of this refresh shows here when it finishes.
